core_obligations: Translate the tensor product to stalks and rewrite the three membership conditions (proof lines 326-337).
Apply the algebra statement to conclude, including the locally Noetherian equality case (proof lines 338-341).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a flat morphism f : X -> S, a quasi-coherent F on X flat over S and a quasi-coherent G on S, the associated points of F (x) f^*G contain the union over s in Ass_S(G) of Ass_{X_s}(F_s), with equality when S is locally Noetherian (source lines 310-324). The proof translates everything to stalks: with B = O_{X,x}, A = O_{S,s}, N = F_x and M = G_s, the stalk of the tensor product is M (x)_A N, and the three membership statements turn into conditions on Ass_B(M (x)_A N), Ass_A(M) and Ass of the fibre N (x) k(m_A), so the claim becomes the corresponding algebra statement, applied in its flat case.
